headline: 2020 order directs federal priority-setting and distribution of health and medical supplies to respond to COVID-19.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with how the federal government prioritizes and allocates health and medical resources during the COVID-19 outbreak. Based on its title, it lets the government decide which needs come first and where scarce medical supplies go. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies act and which supplies are covered are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that make or sell medical supplies and equipment
who_it_affects.how: They may be asked or required to fill certain government-priority orders first.
How they receive scarce medical supplies may depend on federal priority and allocation decisions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 18, 2020; the provided material does not state a separate effective date.
